basis: Malignant neoplasm of cutaneous vascular endothelium; both skin and blood vessels constitute its origin.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: angiosarcoma originates in blood-vessel endothelium; the cardiovascular axis includes cutaneous vessels.

basis: Skeletal myopathy caused by an inherited O-glycosylation defect; brain, eye and cardiac involvement lack established frequencies across the umbrella.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: defective alpha-dystroglycan O-glycosylation establishes an inborn glycosylation disorder, beyond gene association alone.

basis: Neonatal blood/marrow malignancy; hepatic leukemic infiltration occurs in ~70-80%, and cutaneous infiltration in roughly 30-50%, varying between series.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: persistent leukemic skin infiltration occurs in roughly 30-50% of neonatal cases; estimates vary around the threshold.

basis: Epithelial ovarian neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation; reproductive origin without established origin in gonadal hormone-producing tissue.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: neuroendocrine differentiation and broad endocrine-neoplasm ancestry do not establish origin in gonadal hormone-producing tissue.

basis: Hearing loss spans the principal WFS1 phenotypes. Diabetes and optic atrophy characterize syndromic subsets; their prevalence across the umbrella is unestablished.

decisions.ocular: none: optic atrophy defines syndromic subsets but is absent from isolated hearing-loss disease; common involvement across the umbrella is unestablished.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: diabetes defines syndromic subsets but is absent from isolated hearing-loss disease; common involvement across the umbrella is unestablished.

basis: Glycogen storage disease defined by central/peripheral neurodegeneration and progressive neurogenic bladder (80-99%); skin ulcers are secondary.

decisions.renal: primary: progressive neurogenic bladder is a defining urinary-organ loss of function (80-99%), integral to APBD despite its neural cause.

basis: Defining skeletal and oral malformations; intellectual disability and sensorineural hearing loss each 30-79%. Common nail/hair dysplasia omitted by cap in favor of greater functional damage.

decisions.neurologic: involved: intellectual disability is documented in 30-79% and represents persistent neurodevelopmental impairment.
decisions.dermatologic: none by cap: defining nail/hair dysplasia is common, but skeletal/oral malformations, intellectual disability and hearing loss have greater functional consequences.
decisions.otologic: involved: sensorineural hearing impairment is documented in 30-79%; retained under the cap because it causes lasting functional loss.

basis: Ulnar hypoplasia and intellectual disability define the syndrome; microtia is permanent external-ear hypoplasia in 30-79%. Hirsutism alone does not establish skin damage.

decisions.otologic: involved: microtia is structural hypoplasia of the external ear in 30-79%, exceeding a positional or cosmetic ear variant.

basis: Defining CNS injury and craniofacial/limb skeletal malformations; micrognathia occurs in 80-99%, zygomatic hypoplasia in 30-79%; hydronephrosis occurs in 30-79%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: craniofacial/limb malformations are defining features, supported by micrognathia (80-99%) and zygomatic bone hypoplasia (30-79%).

basis: Inherited mitochondrial disorder manifesting as isolated sensorineural hearing loss; explicit oxidative-phosphorylation ancestry supports the metabolic mechanism.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the record explicitly classifies this as an inborn mitochondrial oxidative-phosphorylation disorder; a systemic phenotype is not required.
